mathematical_contracts: Every operation declares physical-row/snapshot, encoded-assignment, formal-parameter or geometric domain.
NULL validity, bag multiplicity and group presence are separate state components.
Snapshot-certified relations are distinct from universal laws, enforced schema guarantees and statistical hypotheses.

first_slice.scope: Checked native rational polynomial functions and immutable scalar degree-two moment contraction. Bounds: <=8 formal variables, total degree<=8, <=128 terms, int64 rational representation; one to four nonnullable INTEGER data variables with affine codecs/stored codes<=32 bits. Scope materialization uses existing native reductions; coefficient algebra and calculus run in native CPU code.
exclusions: No general typed heterogeneous stage DAG.
No fused single-pass moment reducer claim.
No nullable, decimal-column, wide, grouped, range-join or moved-key delta moment states in this slice.
No general transcendental, probability, graph, topology, inverse or optimization implementation claim.
backend_semantics: engine=gpu requests existing actual CUDA aggregate queries for moment materialization where supported, with actual devices recorded.
Function reduction, rational polynomial arithmetic, evaluation, differentiation and integration run in native CPU code.
No new GPU calculus kernel, generic heterogeneous IR or fused multi-output reducer is claimed.
